list_child.name: list_register_intakes
list_child.desc: Retrieve every counseling intake held in the clinic's intake register, across every clinician and every stage of review.

decoys.name: list_waitlist_intakes
decoys.desc: Retrieve every counseling intake held on the group therapy waitlist, across every clinician and every stage of review.

decoys.name: list_referral_intakes
decoys.desc: Retrieve every counseling intake received through the hospital referral portal, across every clinician and every stage of review.

decoys.name: list_supervision_intakes
decoys.desc: Retrieve every counseling intake queued for peer supervision, across every clinician and every stage of review.

get_child.name: get_intake_record
get_child.desc: Look up the main record for a single counseling intake using its unique identifier and return its current details.

decoys.name: get_intake_assessment
decoys.desc: Look up the screening assessment for a single counseling intake using its unique identifier and return its scored answers.

decoys.name: get_intake_consent
decoys.desc: Look up the signed consent forms for a single counseling intake using its unique identifier and return their current details.

decoys.name: get_intake_safety
decoys.desc: Look up the safety plan for a single counseling intake using its unique identifier and return its current details.

list_parent.name: list_clinic_clients
list_parent.desc: Retrieve the full roster of clients currently registered with the clinic, along with their contact details.

decoys.name: list_group_clients
decoys.desc: Retrieve the full roster of clients currently enrolled in group therapy programs, along with their contact details.

decoys.name: list_eap_clients
decoys.desc: Retrieve the full roster of clients currently referred through employer assistance programs, along with their contact details.

decoys.name: list_telehealth_clients
decoys.desc: Retrieve the full roster of clients currently registered for telehealth sessions, along with their contact details.

get_parent.name: get_client_record
get_parent.desc: Look up a single client's record using their unique identifier and return its current details.

decoys.name: get_client_insurance
decoys.desc: Look up a single client's insurance coverage using their unique identifier and return its current details.

decoys.name: get_client_contacts
decoys.desc: Look up a single client's emergency contacts using their unique identifier and return their current details.

decoys.name: get_client_billing
decoys.desc: Look up a single client's billing account using their unique identifier and return its current balance.

delete_child.name: delete_intake_record
delete_child.desc: Permanently erase a counseling intake record from the system; this cannot be undone once it has been confirmed.

decoys.name: delete_intake_recording
decoys.desc: Permanently erase the session audio recording attached to a counseling intake; this cannot be undone once it has been confirmed.

decoys.name: shred_intake_forms
decoys.desc: Permanently shred the scanned paper forms attached to a counseling intake; this cannot be undone once it has been confirmed.

decoys.name: revoke_intake_consent
decoys.desc: Permanently revoke the information-sharing consent on a counseling intake; this cannot be undone once it has been confirmed.
verbs: pull the release of information for {obj}

set_enum.name: set_intake_stage
set_enum.desc: Update the review stage of a counseling intake, moving it between pending, under review, cleared, and closed as the clinical process advances.

decoys.name: recommend_intake_stage
decoys.desc: Record the review stage the intake coordinator recommends for a counseling intake, among pending, under review, cleared, and closed, ahead of the team meeting.

decoys.name: schedule_intake_stage
decoys.desc: Schedule a counseling intake to move to a given review stage among pending, under review, cleared, and closed at the next team meeting.

decoys.name: alert_intake_stage
decoys.desc: Set an alert that fires when a counseling intake reaches a given review stage among pending, under review, cleared, and closed, for the assigned clinician.

set_bool.name: flag_intake_risk
set_bool.desc: Mark a counseling intake as carrying a risk flag so that clinical staff review it with elevated urgency.

decoys.name: flag_intake_authorized
decoys.desc: Mark a counseling intake as authorized by insurance so that billing staff can schedule covered sessions.

decoys.name: flag_intake_interpreter
decoys.desc: Mark a counseling intake as needing an interpreter so that front desk staff book one for each session.

decoys.name: flag_intake_minor
decoys.desc: Mark a counseling intake as involving a minor so that guardian consent is gathered before any session.

set_ref.name: reassign_intake_client
set_ref.desc: Move a counseling intake record so that it is associated with a different client, for example after a registration mix-up at the front desk.

decoys.name: link_intake_guardian
decoys.desc: Link a counseling intake record to a different client who acts as guardian, for example when a parent consents on behalf of a minor.

decoys.name: bill_intake_client
decoys.desc: Bill a counseling intake record to a different client's insurance policy, for example when a spouse holds the family coverage.

decoys.name: share_intake_client
decoys.desc: Share a counseling intake record with a different client for couples work, for example when partners attend sessions together.

send.name: text_client
send.desc: Send a text message to a client regarding their counseling intake, using the clinic's standard secure messaging channel.
child_verbs: give the client on {obj} a heads-up

decoys.name: call_client
decoys.desc: Place a phone call to a client regarding their counseling intake, using the clinic's standard secure phone line.

decoys.name: mail_client
decoys.desc: Send a letter by post to a client regarding their counseling intake, using the clinic's standard mailing address on file.
child_verbs: mail a letter to the client on {obj}
post the client on {obj} a letter

decoys.name: invoice_client
decoys.desc: Send an invoice to a client regarding their counseling intake, using the clinic's standard billing channel.
child_verbs: send the client on {obj} a bill

create.name: create_intake
create.desc: Open a new counseling intake for a client, with an optional presenting concern and starting review stage, when the client first contacts the clinic.

decoys.name: create_referral
decoys.desc: Open a new outbound referral for a client, with an optional presenting concern and starting review stage, when the client needs a specialist elsewhere.

decoys.name: create_screening
decoys.desc: Open a new crisis screening for a client, with an optional presenting concern and starting review stage, when the client calls the line in distress.

decoys.name: create_reassessment
decoys.desc: Open a new annual reassessment for a client, with an optional presenting concern and starting review stage, when a year of treatment has passed.

list_notes.name: list_intake_notes
list_notes.desc: Retrieve the notes attached to a single counseling intake, including every remark clinical staff have logged against it.

decoys.name: list_intake_goals
decoys.desc: Retrieve the treatment goals attached to a single counseling intake, including every target clinical staff have set for it.

decoys.name: list_intake_contacts
decoys.desc: Retrieve the collateral contacts attached to a single counseling intake, including every call staff have made to family about it.

decoys.name: list_intake_screens
decoys.desc: Retrieve the screening scores attached to a single counseling intake, including every questionnaire result staff have logged against it.

add_note.name: add_intake_note
add_note.desc: Attach a new note to a counseling intake, with an optional title, to record a remark from clinical staff.

decoys.name: add_intake_goal
decoys.desc: Attach a new treatment goal to a counseling intake, with an optional title, to record a target agreed with the client.

decoys.name: add_intake_contact
decoys.desc: Attach a new collateral contact to a counseling intake, with an optional title, to record a call with a family member.

decoys.name: add_intake_screen
decoys.desc: Attach a new screening score to a counseling intake, with an optional title, to record a questionnaire result.

update_note.name: update_intake_note
update_note.desc: Change the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on a counseling intake, to correct or expand the remark.

decoys.name: cosign_intake_note
decoys.desc: Co-sign an existing note on a counseling intake with a supervisor's comment and an optional title, to confirm the remark.

decoys.name: score_intake_goal
decoys.desc: Record progress on an existing treatment goal on a counseling intake, with text and an optional title, to track the goal.

decoys.name: reply_intake_note
decoys.desc: Post a reply, with an optional title, under an existing note on a counseling intake, to answer the remark.

delete_note.name: delete_intake_note
delete_note.desc: Permanently remove a note from a counseling intake; the note cannot be recovered once removed.

decoys.name: retire_intake_goal
decoys.desc: Permanently retire a treatment goal from a counseling intake; the goal cannot be recovered once retired.

decoys.name: strike_intake_screen
decoys.desc: Permanently strike a screening score from a counseling intake; the score cannot be recovered once struck.

decoys.name: redact_intake_note
decoys.desc: Permanently redact the text of a note on a counseling intake; the wording cannot be recovered once redacted.

set_image.name: set_intake_image
set_image.desc: Set the image shown on a counseling intake record, typically a profile photo the client has chosen to share.

decoys.name: set_intake_card
decoys.desc: Set the scanned insurance card on a counseling intake record, typically captured by front desk staff at check-in.

decoys.name: set_intake_idscan
decoys.desc: Set the scanned photo ID on a counseling intake record, typically captured by front desk staff at the first visit.

decoys.name: set_intake_drawing
decoys.desc: Set the art therapy drawing on a counseling intake record, typically made by the client during a session.

writer.name: draft_message
writer.desc: Write a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the counseling intakes it should mention, returning the finished text.

decoys.name: draft_summary
decoys.desc: Write a discharge summary from a brief, which states the outcome in the clinician's own words, and the counseling intakes it covers, returning the finished text.

decoys.name: draft_referral
decoys.desc: Write a referral letter from a brief, which states the reason in the clinician's own words, and the counseling intakes it concerns, returning the finished text.

decoys.name: draft_appeal
decoys.desc: Write an insurance appeal letter from a brief, which states the case in the biller's own words, and the counseling intakes it covers, returning the finished text.

image.name: generate_art
image.desc: Generate an illustration from a text prompt and return its URL, with an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: generate_handout
decoys.desc: Generate a psychoeducation handout graphic from a text prompt and return its URL, with an optional visual style.

decoys.name: generate_scene
decoys.desc: Generate a calming guided-imagery scene from a text prompt and return its URL, with an optional visual style.

decoys.name: generate_chart
decoys.desc: Generate a mood tracking chart from a text prompt and return its URL, with an optional visual style for the result.

search.name: search_help
search.desc: Search the help docs and knowledge base with a question and return the best matching passage, as a quick way to check how the intake system works.

decoys.name: search_dsm
decoys.desc: Search the diagnostic manual with a question and return the best matching passage, as a quick way to check the criteria for a presenting concern.

decoys.name: search_protocols
decoys.desc: Search the clinic's crisis protocols with a question and return the best matching passage, as a quick way to check the steps for a risk case.

decoys.name: search_payers
decoys.desc: Search the insurance payer guides with a question and return the best matching passage, as a quick way to check what a plan covers.
